blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: While video diffusion models have grown faster and increasingly streamable, the video VAE remains a primary latency bottleneck across interactive generation and editing pipelines. Existing VAEs and their acceleration methods rely mainly on heavy convolutions or full frame attention, and most focus only on decoding, leaving encoding costly for streaming conditional generation and editing. This raises a natural question: Do video VAE encoding and decoding actually require such global spatiotemporal modeling? By analyzing the effective receptive fields of pretrained video VAEs, we find that both encoding and decoding a patch rely almost entirely on its spatial and temporal neighbors. To exploit this strong locality, we introduce LiveVAE, a streaming encoder and decoder built on causal window attention, which cuts per frame compute while keeping the temporal KV cache bounded for streaming. Decoupled encoder/decoder distillation followed by joint finetuning preserves the pretrained latent space, making LiveVAE a drop-in replacement for the original VAE. On MiniMax-H3, LiveVAE achieves 5.2-6.2x faster encoding and 3.0-3.3x faster decoding than the official VAE with higher PSNR. Paired with our dedicated inference infrastructure, LiveVAE pushes the speedup to 13.4x with almost no quality loss. Code and models will be released.
blocks.zh: 虽然视频传播模式发展得更快,而且越来越可以流出,但视频VAE仍然是跨互动生成和编辑管道的主要后遗症。 现有的VAEs及其加速方法主要依靠重回式或全帧的注意,大多数只注重解码,使得编码成本昂贵,用于流出条件生成和编辑. 这自然提出了一个问题: 视频VAE编码和解码是否真的需要这样的全球spatiental建模? 通过分析预训视频VAEs的有效可接受域,我们发现一个补丁的编码和解码几乎完全依赖于其空间和时间相邻. 为了利用这个强大的位置,我们引入了LiveVAE,一个以因果窗口注意力为主的流线编码器和解码器,它削减了每个帧的计算,同时将时间KV缓存限定为流线. 脱钩接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接 在MiniMax-H3上,LiveVAE比PSNR更高的官方VAE更快地实现了5.2-6.2x的编码和3.0-3.3x的解码. blocks.en: Video diffusion models ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Wan Team, 2025 ; Kong et al., 2024 ) increasingly target real time generation, streaming video editing, and reference to video generation. Such models comprise two core components: a video VAE ( Kingma & Welling, 2014 ) that maps between pixels and a compact latent space, and a diffusion Transformer ( Peebles & Xie, 2023 ) that generates within this latent space. Recent advances in causal diffusion with KV caching ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Yin et al., 2025 ) and few step autoregressive distillation ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) have reduced DiT sampling to just a few causal steps, shifting the primary latency bottleneck to the video VAE. In real time generation, the Wan2.2 VAE decoder alone accounts for 64.6% of total inference time at 720p ( Shin et al., 2026 ; Kang & Kwak, 2026 ) . Moreover, in streaming video editing and reference to video generation, the encoder must compress incoming video frames or visual references into latents on the fly, a step that can take even longer than decoding ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . Supporting these interactive pipelines therefore requires fast streaming for both encoding and decoding, rather than decoding alone.
blocks.zh: 视频传播模式(Rombach等,2022;Yang等,2025;Wan Team,2025;Kong等,2024) 日益针对实时生成,流媒体视频编辑,并参考视频生成. 这些模型由两个核心部分组成:一个是图像VAE(Kingma & Welling,2014年),在像素和紧凑的潜在空间之间绘制地图;另一个是扩散变形器(Peebles & Xie,2023年),在这个潜在空间内生成. KV craching(Chen等,2024;Yin等,2025;)的因果扩散方面的最新进展,以及很少一步自相递进取的蒸馏(Huang等,2025;Liu等,2026),使得DiT采样减少为仅几个因果步骤,将主缓发瓶颈转移到视频VAE上. 在实时生成中,单是Wan2.2 VAE解码器就占了720p总推断时间的64.6%. (Shin等,2026;Kang & Kwak,2026). 此外,在流媒体视频编辑和提及视频生成时,编码器必须将所接入的视频帧或视觉引用压缩为苍蝇上的潜在,这一步骤可能比解码还要长(Zhao等,2026年). 因此,支持这些交互式管道需要快速地流出来进行编码和解码,而不是单独进行解码.

blocks.en: Existing video VAEs and acceleration methods struggle to meet these requirements. Mainstream video VAEs rely on heavy causal 3D convolutions ( Yu et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Wan Team, 2025 ; Kong et al., 2024 ) whose computational cost scales rapidly with resolution, and prior acceleration efforts focus almost exclusively on the decoder while leaving streaming encoding largely unexplored. Among decoder only methods, distilling or pruning convolutional architectures ( Boer Bohan, 2025 ; Gu et al., 2026 ; Zou et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) often trades reconstruction fidelity for speed or retains substantial convolutional overhead. Streaming Transformer decoders, e.g . FlashDecoder ( Kang & Kwak, 2026 ) , bound temporal history with a KV cache but still attend over the entire latent, incurring quadratic cost in the number of spatial tokens. This raises a fundamental question: Do video VAE encoding and decoding actually require such global spatiotemporal modeling?

blocks.en: To answer this question, we analyze the effective receptive fields ( Luo et al., 2016 ) of pretrained video VAEs, including MiniMax-H3 ( MiniMax, 2026 ) and Wan2.2 ( Wan Team, 2025 ) , using normalized squared input gradients, and cross check the temporal behavior with a gradient free frame replacement test ( Zeiler & Fergus, 2014 ; Huang et al., 2018 ) . As shown in Fig. 2 , the dependencies between input and output concentrate around the target in both encoders and decoders. Spatially, a compact 7 × 7 7\times 7 neighborhood around the target location holds 95–100% of the gradient energy in Fig. 2 b. Temporally, the current and immediately preceding steps hold 71–99% in Fig. 2 c. Replacing a single input step changes the output two steps later by only 0.5–1.5% for the decoders and 4–12% for the encoders, relative to the change caused by replacing the entire sequence.
blocks.zh: 为了回答这个问题,我们用正方形输入梯度分析预训视频VAEs的有效可接受性域(Luo等,2016年),包括MiniMax-H3(MiniMax,2026年)和Wan2.2(Wan Team,2025年),并用梯度自由帧替换测试来交叉检查时间行为(Zeiler等,2014年;Huang等,2018年). 如图2所显示,输入和输出之间的依赖性在编码器和解码器中都集中在目标周围. 在空间方面,一个紧凑的7×7 7\时,目标地点周围的7个街区拥有图2b的95-100%的梯度能。 暂时来说,当前和紧接之前的步骤占据了图7的71-99 % 。 2 c. 替换一个输入步骤, 相对于替换整个序列引起的变化, 后期输出两个步骤只为解码器0. 5– 1.5%, 编码器4– 12%.

blocks.en: To exploit this locality, we introduce LiveVAE , a streaming video encoder and decoder built on causal window attention. Spatially, restricting attention to a local window eliminates redundant computation to lower latency and enables direct extrapolation to higher resolutions by modeling only local patterns. Temporally, the causal window bounds the KV cache for continuous streaming. To preserve the pretrained latent space, we train LiveVAE via a three stage distillation framework. We first independently distill the encoder and decoder in latent and pixel spaces against the frozen pretrained VAE, and then jointly finetune both modules end to end. This alignment allows LiveVAE to directly replace the original VAE. On MiniMax-H3 ( MiniMax, 2026 ) , LiveVAE achieves 5.2 5.2 – 6.2 × 6.2\times faster encoding and 3.0 3.0 – 3.3 × 3.3\times faster decoding than the official VAE while matching or exceeding its PSNR from 480p to 2160p.
blocks.zh: 为了利用这个地方,我们引入了LiveVAE, 一个以因果窗口注意力为基础的流媒体编码和解码器。 空间方面,将注意力限制在本地窗口上,可以消除冗余计算来降低延迟度,并且只能通过模拟本地模式直接推导出更高的分辨率. 暂时,因果窗口将 KV 缓存绑定为连续流. 为了保存预受训练的潜在空间,我们通过三级蒸馏框架来训练LiveVAE. 我们首先独立地将编码器和解码器在潜在和像素空间中蒸馏出与被冻结的预先训练的VAE相对抗,然后共同微调两个模块最终会结束. 这种对接使得LiveVAE可以直接取代原来的VAE. 在MiniMax-H3(MiniMax,2026年)上,LiveVAE在从480p到2160p的比对或超过其PSNR时,实现了5.2 – 6.2 × 6.2\tims更快的编码和3.0 3.0 →3.3 × 3.3\tims的解码速度快于官方VAE.

blocks.en: To further translate this architectural efficiency into hardware speedups, we build a dedicated inference infrastructure ( Section 3.4 ) incorporating attention operator fusion, region wise compilation, and FP8 quantization aware training. With it, LiveVAE pushes the end to end speedup up to 13.4 × 13.4\times with negligible quality loss, matching the official VAE in downstream reference to video generation.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步将这种建筑效率转化为硬件加速,我们建立了一个专门的推论基础设施(第3.4节),其中包括注意力操作员聚变、区域明智汇编和FP8量化意识培训。 与之相伴而来,LiveVAE将最终速度推向了13.4×13.4\时,质量损失可忽略不计,与下游参考视频生成的官方VAE相匹配.

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are as follows: • Through effective receptive field and perturbation analyses of pretrained video VAEs, we show that video encoding and decoding rely almost entirely on local spatial and temporal neighborhoods. • We propose LiveVAE, the first Transformer based streaming video encoder and decoder built on causal window attention, which eliminates redundant computation to lower latency, extrapolates from 720p to 2160p with even higher PSNR, and bounds the temporal KV cache. • We design a three stage distillation framework that preserves the pretrained latent space, enabling LiveVAE to directly replace the original VAE. • We develop a dedicated inference infrastructure for LiveVAE, pushing end to end speedup up to 13.4 × 13.4\times on MiniMax-H3 with almost no quality loss.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,我们的贡献如下:通过对经过预先训练的视频VAE进行有效的可接受性和扰动性分析,我们显示视频编码和解码几乎完全依赖于当地的空间和时间街区。 我们提出LiveVAE,这是第一个基于因果窗口注意力的变形器流媒体编码器和解码器,它消除了冗余计算来降低延迟度,用更高的PSNR推断出从720p到2160p,并限定了时间KV缓存. ^ 我们设计了三相蒸馏框架,保留了被预先训练出的潜在空间,使LiveVAE能够直接取代原有的VAE. 我们为LiveVAE开发了专门的推论基础设施,推动结束速度达到13.4×13.4\时间在MiniMax-H3上几乎没有质量损失.

blocks.en: 2  Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Latent diffusion ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) trains the generator in the compact latent space of a pretrained VAE ( Kingma & Welling, 2014 ) , and diffusion Transformers (DiTs) ( Peebles & Xie, 2023 ) have scaled this recipe to video ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Wan Team, 2025 ; Kong et al., 2024 ; HaCohen et al., 2024 ; NVIDIA, 2025 ) . The latent space is the representation the DiT learns from, and the quality of this representation largely determines how fast the DiT converges and how well it generates ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Singh et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2025 ) . Existing work therefore designs the latent space for the generator. One line raises the compression ratio so that the DiT processes fewer tokens ( Chen et al., 2025 ; HaCohen et al., 2024 ) , with causal 3D convolutions that compress time as well ( Yu et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . Another aligns the latents with pretrained visual representations. VA-VAE ( Yao et al., 2025 ) aligns them with vision foundation models to ease the tradeoff between reconstruction and generation, and REPA-E ( Leng et al., 2025 ) tunes the VAE and the DiT end to end through such an alignment. A third uses these representations directly as latents. RAE ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) pairs a frozen representation encoder with a trained decoder. Each design defines a new latent space on which the DiT is then trained, and once the DiT is trained, this latent space is fixed. CV-VAE ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) thus keeps a new video VAE compatible with the latent space of a pretrained image VAE. Our work is orthogonal to these designs. Whichever latent space a DiT is trained on, we keep it and replace only the encoder and decoder that compute it with streaming ones.
blocks.zh: Latent扩散(Rombach等,2022年)在预训VAE(Kingma & Welling,2014年)的紧凑潜在空间中培训发电机,并传播变形器(DiTs)(Peebles & Xie,2023年)将该配方缩放为视频(Yang等,2025年;Wan Team,2025年;Kong等,2024年;HaCohen等,2024年;NVIDIA,2025年)。 潜在的空间是DiT从中汲取的能见度,而这种能见度的质量在很大程度上决定了DiT的聚合速度和产生效果(Yu等,2025;Singh等,2026;Yao等,2025)。 因此,现有工作为发电机设计了潜在的空间。 一条线提高了压缩比,使DiT处理的活度减少(Chen等,2025;HaCohen等,2024;有因果的3D演化也压缩了时间(Yu等,2024;Yang等,2025)。 另一个将潜伏物与预受训练的视觉表现相配合. VA-VAE(姚等,2025年)将它们与愿景基础模型相配合,以缓解重建与世代之间的取舍,而REPA-E(Leng等,2025年)则通过这样的对接来调和VAE和DiT结束. 三分之一直接使用这些表述作为潜在。 RAE (Zheng等, 2026年)用训练有素的解码器为一对被冻结的表示编码器. 每个设计都定义了一个新的潜伏空间,然后DiT在其中被训练,一旦DiT被训练,这个潜伏空间就固定了. CV-VAE (Zhao等, 2024年)因此保留了一款新视频VAE兼容预受训练图像VAE的潜在空间. 我们的工作是正统的 这些设计。 无论DiT的潜入空间被训练过, 我们保留它, 并且只替换编码器和解码器 用流来计算它。

blocks.en: On the generator side, video generation has become causal and fast. Diffusion Forcing ( Chen et al., 2024 ) and CausVid ( Yin et al., 2025 ) generate one frame at a time with a KV cache, and Self Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025 ) and Rolling Forcing ( Liu et al., 2026 ) close the train-test gap and generate long videos in real time with a few denoising steps. Once the generator needs only a few causal steps, the bottleneck shifts to the VAE. Few step autoregressive distillation raises the decoder’s share of latency by more than ten times ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) , the Wan2.2 decoder takes 64.6% of the inference time of MotionStream ( Shin et al., 2026 ) at 720p ( Kang & Kwak, 2026 ) , and in streaming video editing, where the input video is also encoded, VAE encoding takes longer than decoding ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . Streaming generation thus needs both a streaming decoder and a streaming encoder.

blocks.en: Almost all video VAE acceleration methods accelerate only the decoder. We group them by whether they keep the latent space of the DiT. Lightweight VAEs trained from scratch ( Cheng et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) define a new latent space, so the DiT must be retrained or finetuned. The others keep the latent space. Distilled and pruned decoders reduce per frame cost. TAEHV ( Boer Bohan, 2025 ) and LightVAE ( Gu et al., 2026 ) distill a lighter decoder that trades fidelity for speed, while Turbo-VAED ( Zou et al., 2026 ) and Flash-VAED ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) prune and replace the original decoder’s causal 3D convolutions, whose cost still grows with resolution. Streaming decoders instead reduce latency by decoding as the latents arrive. Some make a bidirectional decoder causal ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) , and FlashDecoder ( Kang & Kwak, 2026 ) , closest to ours, is a Transformer decoder that streams one latent frame at a time with a rolling KV cache. Its tokens attend to the full current and previous frames, so its cost grows quadratically with resolution, and it requires multiresolution training up to higher resolution; ours attend to a fixed local window, scale linearly, and are trained only at low resolutions, yet extrapolate directly to higher resolutions at inference time.
blocks.zh: 几乎所有的视频VAE加速方法只加速解码器. 我们通过它们是否从零开始保留DiT.轻量级VAEs的潜在空间来划分它们(Cheng等人,2025年;Li等人,2025年;Wu等人,2025年)定义了一个新的潜在空间,因此DiT必须重新训练或微调. 其他人保持潜在的空间。 蒸发和破损的解码器可减少每帧成本。 TAEHV (Buer Bohan, 2025年)和LightVAE (Gu等, 2026年) 蒸馏出一个以纯度为交易速度的更轻的解码器,而Turbo-VAED (Zou等, 2026年)和Flash-VAED (Zhu等, 2026年) prune并取代了最初的解码器因果3D分解,其成本仍会随着分辨率而增加. 流出解码器反而在潜伏物到达时通过解码来减少延迟. 有的制作双向解码器因子(Chen等,2026;Lu等,2026;Zhao等,2026;FlashDecoder(Kang & Kwak,2026)),与我们最接近,是一款变形器解码器,以滚动的KV缓存一时流出一股潜伏框架. 它的标志关注当前和以往的全部框架,因此其成本随着分辨率的提高而四倍增长,它需要多分辨率培训直至更高分辨率;我们的标志关注一个固定的本地窗口,线性规模,并且只接受低分辨率培训,但在推断时间直接推导到更高分辨率.

blocks.en: 3  Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We distill pretrained video VAEs into LiveVAE , a streaming autoencoder built on causal window attention that preserves full compatibility with existing diffusion models as illustrated in Fig. 3 . Section 3.1 reviews the preliminaries and problem formulation, Section 3.2 introduces causal window attention, Section 3.3 presents our network architecture and three stage progressive distillation, and Section 3.4 details the inference infrastructure optimization.
blocks.zh: 我们把预先训练的视频VAEs分馏到LiveVAE中,这是一个以因果窗口注意力为基础的流出自编码器,它保持了与Fig所显示的现有传播模型的充分相容性. 3 第3.1节审查初步情况和问题表述,第3.2节介绍因果窗口注意,第3.3节介绍我们的网络结构和三个阶段的渐进分馏,第3.4节详细说明推论基础设施的优化。

blocks.en: 3.3  Architecture and Progressive Distillation
blocks.zh: 3.3 建筑和逐步消沉

blocks.en: Unlike multiscale convolutional VAEs that expend heavy computation on high resolution feature maps, ℰ S \mathcal{E}_{S} and 𝒟 S \mathcal{D}_{S} use a symmetric backbone of L L CWA blocks operating directly on the f × h × w f\times h\times w latent grid in Fig. 3 a. The encoder patchifies incoming frame chunks via a linear projection, processes tokens through the CWA blocks, and projects them to the latent channels before normalizing with the teacher’s channelwise statistics; symmetrically, the decoder denormalizes incoming latents, applies the CWA blocks, and unpatchifies hidden features back to pixels.

blocks.en: 3.4  Inference Infrastructure Optimization

blocks.en: To further accelerate streaming inference, we introduce three system optimizations on NVIDIA H100 GPUs rented from RunPod that yield up to a 3.0 × 3.0\times end to end speedup with negligible quality loss ( Fig. 5 ). These optimizations are enabled only for Ours-Opt in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 为了进一步加速流推论,我们对从RunPod租来的NVIDIA H100 GPU引入了三个系统优化,其输出量可达3.0×3.0\times以可忽略不计的质量损失结束速度(图5). 这些优化仅在表1中启用。

blocks.en: Running query key normalization, 3D RoPE, 2D window attention, and the cross frame merge of Eq. 5 separately incurs heavy memory traffic from intermediate tensors. We fuse query key normalization with 3D RoPE into one kernel and fold the cross frame merge directly into the window attention kernel, so that the fused attention path reads and writes global memory only at its inputs and outputs. The window attention kernel attends over the full causal window with an online softmax, so the merge needs no separate pass.
blocks.zh: 运行查询密钥正常化,3D ROPE,2D窗口关注,和Eq. 5的跨相框合并,分别产生从中间的收录器的重内存流量. 我们用3D RoPE将查询密钥正常化连接到一个内核中,并将跨帧直接合并到窗口注意力内核中,这样被连接的注意力路径只在其输入和输出时读取和写入全局内存. 窗口关注内核会用在线软max在全因子窗口上方出席,因此合并不需要单独通过.

blocks.en: Compiling the whole model with torch.compile suffers from graph breaks around custom attention kernels and recompilations during KV cache warmup. Instead, we compile only the four static subgraphs in each block, namely the normalization before attention, QKV projection, output projection, and the residual FFN, while leaving the CWA kernels and cache control flow uncompiled in the outer loop.
blocks.zh: 用火炬把整个模型拼凑起来. 编译遇到自定义关注内核周围的图断和在 KV 缓存取暖时的再编译等问题. 相反,我们只编译了每个块的四个静态子图,即注意前的常态,QKV投影,输出投影,和剩余FFN,同时使CWA内核和缓存控制流在外环中不相容.

blocks.en: With attention made lightweight, the FFN dominates computation, so we quantize the FFN linear layers to FP8 in all encoder blocks and in every decoder block except the last. To avoid the quality drop of direct post-training quantization, we apply quantization aware training, denoted QAT, under Eq. 12 by simulating FP8 precision during finetuning. Attention and normalization retain their original precision.
blocks.zh: 由于注意轻量级,FFN在计算中占主导地位,所以我们把所有编码器区块和除最后一个外的每个解码器区块的FFN线性地层量化为FP8. 为了避免直接训练后量化的质量下降,我们在Eq. 12下采用量化意识培训,在微调时模拟FP8精度。 注意和正常化保持原有的准确性。

blocks.en: Choice of layers. We enable FP8 in one block at a time on the model before QAT and measure the change in reconstruction PSNR. The cost is concentrated in the last block of each network: at 480p, PSNR drops by about 0.9 dB for the last encoder block and by more than 7 dB for the last decoder block, against about 0.1 dB for the other 22 blocks together. The inputs of the last decoder FFN far exceed the range of FP8, so part of them saturates. This loss appears to come from dynamic range rather than from rounding precision, which we expect finetuning to recover less easily, while leaving one block out costs little speed. We therefore quantize the FFN of all 12 encoder blocks and of the first 11 decoder blocks, and keep the last decoder block in its original precision. The last encoder block stays quantized, and its loss is the main part that QAT has to recover.
blocks.zh: 分层选择. 我们在QAT之前的模型上一个街区启用FP8,并测量重建PSNR的变化. 成本集中在每个网络的最后一个区块:在480p时,PSNR在最后一个编码器区块上降了约0.9分贝,在最后一个解码器区块上降了超过7分贝,而其他22个区块一起降了约0.1分贝. 最后一个解码器FFN的输入量远远超过了FP8的范围,因此其中一部分是饱和. 这一损失似乎来自动态范围,而不是四舍五入的精度,我们期望微调后恢复得不那么容易,而把一个街区留了下来,成本也很小。 因此,我们将所有12个编码器区块和前11个解码器区块的FFN进行量化,并保持上一个解码器区块的原始精度. 最后一个编码器块仍然被量化,它的损失是QAT必须恢复的主要部分.

blocks.en: 4.1  Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Base VAEs and models. To demonstrate the generalizability of our method across distinct latent representations, we distill LiveVAE from two pretrained video VAEs, MiniMax-H3 ( MiniMax, 2026 ) , denoted H3, and Wan2.2 ( Wan Team, 2025 ) . We call each of them a base VAE and its encoder and decoder the official encoder and decoder; they are the teachers of Section 3.3 . All student encoders and decoders use 12 Transformer layers and a causal attention window of size 2 × 7 × 7 2\times 7\times 7 . The hidden dimensions of the encoder and the decoder are 2048 and 2560 for H3, and 2560 and 2496 for Wan2.2.
blocks.zh: 基础VAE和模型. 为了显示我们的方法在不同的潜在表达方式中的普遍性,我们从两个经过预先训练的视频VAE(MiniMax-H3(MiniMax,2026年))中提炼出LiveVAE,表示H3和Wan2.2(Wan Team,2025年)。 我们称他们各自为基地 VAE 及其编码器和解码器为官方编码器和解码器;他们是第3.3节的教师。 所有学生的编码器和解码器都使用12个变形器层和一个大小为2×7×7的因果关注窗口 7\times 7 (英语). 编码器和解码器的隐藏尺寸为H3的2048和2560,而Wan2.2的2560和2496.

blocks.en: Training data. We train on an internal collection of videos and images, filtered for motion intensity and category diversity, with images making up 20% of the training samples in all three stages. Videos are 4–6 s clips sampled at 8 to 30 FPS, from which we take 22 frames for H3 and 21 for Wan2.2, at a resolution of 480p or 720p.
blocks.zh: 培训数据。 我们在内部收集视频和图像, 筛选出运动强度和类别多样性, 图像占所有三个阶段培训样本的20%。 视频为从8到30 FPS取出样本的4–6 s剪辑,我们从中取出H3的22帧和Wan2.2的21帧,分辨率为480p或720p.

blocks.en: Training details. All stages use a global batch size of 8 and AdamW with β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 , β 2 = 0.95 \beta_{2}=0.95 , a weight decay of 0.01 and a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , with 1k warmup steps and cosine decay to zero. Stages 1, 2 and 3 take 80k, 200k and 5k steps, and Stage 3 keeps an EMA of the weights with a decay of 0.999. In all stages, the ℓ 1 \ell_{1} and LPIPS terms of Eq. 8 have weights of 1 and λ p = 0.33 \lambda_{\mathrm{p}}=0.33 ; the others are λ z = 1.0 \lambda_{z}=1.0 , λ KL = 10 − 3 \lambda_{\mathrm{KL}}=10^{-3} and λ adv = 0.1 \lambda_{\mathrm{adv}}=0.1 .
blocks.zh: 培训细节。 所有相相均采用全球批量大小为8和亚当W,其中β 1 = 0.9\β1}=0.9,β 2 = 0.95\β2}=0.95,重量衰减为0.01,学习速率为10−4 10^{-4},有 1k 的取暖步骤和余弦衰减为0. 第1,2和3阶段走80k,200k和5k步,第3阶段保留了重量的EMA,衰减为0.999. 在所有阶段,l 1\ell_{1}和LPIPS 的 Eq. 8 名词的权重为 1 和 * = 0.33\lambda_{\mathrm{p}}=0.33; 其他为 λ z = 1.0\lambda_{z}=1.0; λ KL = 10- 3\lambda_{\mathrm{KL}}=10^{-3} 和 λ adv = 0.1\lambda_{\mathrm{adv}}=0.1.

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare with TAEHV ( Boer Bohan, 2025 ) , LightTAE ( LightX2V Team, 2025 ) , LightVAE ( Gu et al., 2026 ) , Turbo-VAED ( Zou et al., 2026 ) , LynnReal-Omni ( Mao et al., 2026 ) , Solar-X ( Chen et al., 2026 ) and StreamRender-H3 ( Lu et al., 2026 ) , using their public weights for the two base VAEs. We run all of them ourselves and evaluate every row of Table 1 by end to end reconstruction. A decoder only baseline is paired with the official encoder of its base VAE; for ours, we also report the two combinations that replace a single official component ( Section 4.2.5 ). An asterisk (*) after a model name marks a streaming encoder or decoder, i.e . a causal one that processes the video chunk by chunk with a bounded cache. Ours-Opt is the infrastructure optimized version of Ours ( Section 3.4 ); no other row uses inference optimization, and all rows run on the same clips and GPU, in the same precision and software environment.
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们比较了TAEHV(布尔·博汉,2025年),LightTAE(LightX2V Team,2025年),LightVAE(顾等,2026年),Turbo-VAED(邹等,2026年),LynnReal-Omni(毛等,2026年),Solar-X. (Chen等,2026年)和StreamRender-H3(Lu等,2026年),为两个基站VAE使用公分. 我们自己管理所有这些项目,并在结束重建之前对表一的每一行进行评估。 仅一个解码器基线与其基础VAE的官方编码器成对;对于我们来说,我们还报告两种组合取代了单一的官方组件(第4.2.5节). 在模型名称后的一个星号( *) 标记了流编码器或解码器, 即一个因果编码器, 用有限制的缓存按块处理视频块 。 Ours-Opt是"Ours"的基础设施优化版本(第3.4节);没有其他行使用推论优化,所有行运行在相同的剪辑和GPU上,在相同的精密和软件环境中.

blocks.en: Evaluation data. We evaluate on 200 clips from UltraVideo ( Xue et al., 2025 ) , of 22 frames for H3 and 21 frames for Wan2.2, each from a different source video and balanced over five motion tiers, at four resolutions: 480p, 720p, 1080p and 2160p. Each resolution is obtained from the source frames in a single step, by bicubic resizing and center cropping; 1080p uses 1920 × 1088 1920\times 1088 , since both base VAEs compress each spatial axis by a factor of 16. Section 4.2.6 repeats the evaluation on longer clips.
blocks.zh: 评价数据。 我们评价来自UltraVideo(薛等,2025年)的200个片段,其中22个为H3帧,21个为Wan2.2帧,每个片段取自不同来源的视频并平衡在5个运动层上,有4个分辨率:480p,720p,1080p和2160p. 每个分辨率都是从源框中以单步得到的,由双立体再生和中心收割得到;1080p使用1920×1088 1920\times 1088,因为两个基站VAEs将每个空间轴压缩一个系数为16. 第4.2.6节重复了对较长片段的评价。

blocks.en: Reconstruction metrics. We report PSNR (in dB), SSIM and LPIPS between reconstructed and original frames, averaged over the clips at each resolution; higher PSNR and SSIM and lower LPIPS are better. Time is the median (p50) latency of the encoder or the decoder alone on one clip, in milliseconds, measured after warmup on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU rented from RunPod, with batch size 1, and the speedup is the time of the official component divided by that of the method. Mem is the peak GPU memory in GB and Params the parameter count in billions.
blocks.zh: 重建指标。 我们报告PSNR(以dB为单位),SSIM和LPIPS介于重建与原始相框之间,在每个分辨率的剪辑上平均;更高的PSNR和SSIM以及较低的LPIPS更好. 时间为一片片段上单独编码器或解码器的中位数(p50),以毫秒为单位,从RunPod租来的单个NVIDIA H100 GPU上取暖后进行测量,分批大小为1,加速度为正元件除以方法的时间. Mem是GB和Params中最高峰的GPU内存,参数数以亿计.

blocks.en: Generation metrics. For text to video generation, we report the five dimension scores of VBench-2.0 ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) , where higher is better. For reference to video generation, we follow CodeVideoBench ( Liang et al., 2026 ) and report its Structure, Style and Quality scores, each from 0 to 100, with Total defined as the mean of the three ( Table 2 ).

blocks.en: 4.2  Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: 4.2.1  Reconstruction Quality
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 重建质量

blocks.en: In Table 1 , LiveVAE exceeds the official H3 teacher in PSNR at all four resolutions by 0.07–0.90 dB, the highest among all methods from 720p upward. Its LPIPS gap to the official H3 VAE narrows from .054 versus .041 at 480p to .034 versus .029 at 2160p and stays close to the streaming decoder only baselines. On both Wan2.2 and H3, Ours outperforms every baseline that replaces both the encoder and the decoder on all metrics, by 3.0–10.5 dB in PSNR. LightVAE-Pro and Turbo-VAED on Wan2.2 and LynnReal-Omni on H3 reach comparable or slightly higher quality at some resolutions, but they replace only the decoder and keep the official encoder at its original speed.
blocks.zh: 在表1中,LiveVAE在所有四项决议中都超过了PSNR的官方H3教师,比起0.07-0.90 dB,是720p上方所有方法中最高的. 它的LPIPS缺口到官方的H3 VAE从0.054对0.041在480p到.034对.029在2160p到. 在Wan2.2和H3上,我们的成绩都超过了所有度量衡上的编码器和解码器的每个基线,比PSNR中的3.0-10.5分贝高。 LightVAE-Pro和Turbo-VAED在Wan2.2上和Lynn Real-Omni在H3上在某些分辨率上达到可比较或略高的质量,但它们只取代了解码器并保持了官方编码器的原速.

blocks.en: 4.2.2  Inference Efficiency
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 推论效率

blocks.en: Tiny models such as TAEH3, TAEW2.2 and LightTAE are faster but trail Ours by more than 4 dB in PSNR. On H3, where official encoding is slower than decoding, Ours accelerates the encoder by 5.2 5.2 – 6.2 × 6.2\times and the decoder by 3.0 3.0 – 3.3 × 3.3\times , whereas the decoder only LynnReal-Omni, Solar-X and StreamRender-H3 reach only 1.3 1.3 – 1.7 × 1.7\times on the decoder and keep the official encoder. With the inference optimizations of Section 3.4 , Ours-Opt reaches up to 18.7 × 18.7\times and 9.5 × 9.5\times within 0.13 dB PSNR. Ours also halves H3 peak memory at 480p from 8.8 to 4.4 GB and needs only 14.1 GB at 2160p, where Solar-X runs out of memory and StreamRender-H3 uses 53.2 GB. On Wan2.2, Ours speeds up decoding by 4.7 4.7 – 6.5 × 6.5\times against 1.6 1.6 – 1.8 × 1.8\times for LightVAE-Pro and Turbo-VAED, speeds up encoding by 1.4 1.4 – 1.6 × 1.6\times , and cuts peak memory at 2160p from 55.9 to 15.7 GB, where LightVAE-Pro and Turbo-VAED need 54 GB or more.

blocks.en: Text to video generation. We evaluate text to video generation on VBench-2.0 ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) in Table 2 with frozen few step DiTs: the 3 step FastWan2.2-TI2V-5B ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) for Wan2.2 and the 4 step Wuli MiniMax-H3 Turbo LoRA ( Wuli-art, 2026 ) for H3. Replacing the decoder on Wan2.2 preserves the overall score at 0.581 versus 0.582, with slight gains in Human Fidelity and Physics. On MiniMax-H3, Ours stays within 0.01 of the official decoder on Creativity, Controllability, and Commonsense, with minor drops in Human Fidelity at 0.784 versus 0.830 and Physics at 0.781 versus 0.802.

Following CodeVideoBench ( Liang et al., 2026 ) with the official MiniMax-H3 weights ( MiniMax, 2026 ) , replacing both the H3 encoder and decoder in Table 2 yields a nearly identical total of 84.0 versus 84.1, improving Style from 86.7 to 87.7 while preserving Structure and Quality, which confirms that both modules remain well aligned with the frozen DiT latent space.

blocks.en: 4.2.4  Resolution Extrapolation
blocks.zh: 4.2.4 分辨率外推法

blocks.en: Trained only at 480p and 720p, LiveVAE extrapolates directly to 1080p and 2160p without finetuning and outperforms the H3 teacher ( MiniMax, 2026 ) in PSNR, aided by local spatial windows and DiT aligned 3D RoPE. Because causal window attention scales linearly with token count, scaling from 720p to 2160p increases H3 encoding and decoding latencies by only 7.9 × 7.9\times and 8.1 × 8.1\times .

blocks.en: 4.3.1  Ablation on Causal Window Attention Design
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 因果关系窗口注意设计

blocks.en: We vary spatial and temporal window sizes to validate our effective receptive field findings ( Fig. 2 ). Each component is trained separately with a shortened schedule, 60k steps for encoders and 120k steps for decoders, and evaluated with its official counterpart, with compilation off. Tables 10 and 11 in Appendix A give the per component numbers.
blocks.zh: 我们的空间和时间窗口大小各不相同,以验证我们有效接受的实地调查结果(图2)。 每个组件分别培训一个缩短的进度表、60k的编码器步骤和120k的解码器步骤,并与其官方对应部门一起进行评估,并取消编译。 附录中的表10和表11 A 给出每个组件数字。

blocks.en: Attention window tradeoff. Fig. 5 plots each candidate window against our default 2 × 7 × 7 2\times 7\times 7 , averaged over the encoder and decoder; we cite per component numbers below. Shrinking the spatial window to 3 × 3 3\times 3 saves no latency and costs up to 0.08 dB on the decoder and 0.33–0.36 dB on the encoder at every resolution. We choose 7 × 7 7\times 7 over 16 × 16 16\times 16 for three reasons. First, 16 × 16 16\times 16 does not extrapolate: its encoder leads 7 × 7 7\times 7 by 0.12 dB at the 480p and 720p training resolutions but trails by 0.06 dB at 1080p and 0.34 dB at 2160p. Second, 7 × 7 7\times 7 shows no such drop, so one model scales directly from low to high resolution. Third, the gain of 16 × 16 16\times 16 is limited, 0.13–0.16 dB on the decoder with LPIPS lower by only 0.001. Temporally, extending T T from 2 to 3 or 4 latent frames increases latency by 11–13% or 21–23% while shifting PSNR by at most 0.22 dB.
blocks.zh: 注意窗口权衡. 图5 每一个候选窗口 相对于我们默认的 2 × 7 × 7 2\times 7, 平均在编码和解码器上; 我们引用下面的每个组件数字 。 将空间窗口缩小为3×3 3\times 3,节省了不耐久性,费用最高可达解码器上0.08分贝和每分辨度上0.33–0.36分贝. 我们选择7×7 7\时间7 16×16 16\时间16 原因有三个. 首先,16×16 16\times 16不推断:它的编码器在480p和720p的训练分辨率上领先了7×7 7\times 7乘以0.12 dB,但在1080p和2160p上则领先了0.06 dB和0.34 dB. 第二,7×7 7\times 7没有显示这种下降,因此一个模型的分级从低分辨率直接到高分辨率. 第三,16×16 16\times 16的增益是有限的,0.13–0.16 dB在与LPIPS的解码器上只低了0.001. 暂时,将T T 从2到3或4个潜在框架延长11-13%或21-23 %,同时转移PSNR最多0.22分贝。

blocks.en: Frame wise 2D decomposition. We compare joint 3D window attention against our mathematically equivalent frame wise 2D decomposition ( Eqs. 4 and 5 ) using identical weights, so reconstruction quality is unchanged. In Table 5 , the joint 3D kernel is 27–28% slower and uses 18–21% more memory at 720p; across all four resolutions, it is 21–29% slower and consumes 9–53% more memory, validating our decomposed formulation.
blocks.zh: 框架智能 二维分解 。 我们用相同的权重来比较联合3D窗口的注意力与我们的数学等效框架智取2D分解(Eqs. 4和5),因此重建质量不变. 在表5中,联合3D内核慢了27–28 % , 在720p时使用了18–21 % 的内存;在所有四个分辨率中,它慢了21–29 % , 消耗了9–53 % 的内存, 验证了我们的分解配方.

blocks.en: RoPE selection. All CWA blocks use the 3D RoPE of the DiT of the base model ( Section 3.3 ). Table 6 compares this choice on H3 with the 3D RoPE of Wan2.2, evaluated end to end. The H3 DiT RoPE row is the Ours row of Table 1 . The difference is small: with the Wan2.2 RoPE, PSNR is lower by 0.11 to 0.23 dB and LPIPS higher by 0.002 to 0.005, while SSIM changes by less than 0.001. The PSNR gap tends to grow with resolution, from 0.11 dB at 480p to 0.23 dB at 2160p. Both variants work, and following the DiT appears to be slightly better, so we keep it as the default for both base VAEs.

blocks.en: 4.3.2  Ablation on Progressive VAE Distillation
blocks.zh: 4.3.2 逐步VAE蒸馏问题

blocks.en: These ablations evaluate the key components of our three stage distillation framework in Section 3.3 : the image and video mixing ratio, joint finetuning in Stage 3, and the choice of adversarial discriminator.
blocks.zh: 这些分解评估了我们第3.3节三个阶段分解框架的关键组成部分:图像和视频混合比率、第三阶段的联合微调以及选择对抗性歧视者。

blocks.en: Image and video mix. Table 7 varies the fraction of images in the training data. At 720p, mixing in 20% images lowers LPIPS from 0.054 to 0.049 at a 0.08 dB PSNR cost, as high resolution still images provide sharper spatial supervision. A 50% ratio brings no further gain, so we adopt 20%.
blocks.zh: 图像和视频混合。 表7对培训数据中图像的分数有差异。 在720p时,混合到20%的图像会以0.08 dB PSNR的成本将LPIPS从0.054降低到0.049,因为高分辨率的静态图像提供更尖锐的空间监督. 50%的比例不会带来进一步的收益,所以我们采用20%的比例。

blocks.en: Table 7: Image and video mix.
blocks.zh: 表7:图像和视频组合。

blocks.en: Joint finetuning. Table 8 ablates joint finetuning on end to end reconstruction. Without it, the Stage 1 encoder is paired directly with the Stage 2 decoder, which was trained only on teacher latents and has never seen student latents. Joint finetuning with Eq. 12 lets the two modules adapt to each other, raising PSNR at 720p by 1.08 dB from 33.66 to 34.74 dB and lowering LPIPS from 0.062 to 0.049. The gain holds at all four resolutions: PSNR rises by 0.32 to 1.29 dB and LPIPS falls by 11 to 21%. Before joint finetuning, the PSNR of our model is below that of the official VAE up to 1080p; after it, it is 0.07 to 0.90 dB above at all four resolutions, while its LPIPS remains higher. The cost is a minor drop when either module is paired with its official counterpart ( Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 联合微调. 表8 减少对结束重建的联合微调。 没有它,阶段一编码器与阶段二解码器直接对接,该解码器只接受过教师潜想的培训,从未见过学生潜想. 与Eq. 12进行联合微调,使两个模块相适应,将PSNR以720p升出1.08分贝从33.66升入34.74分贝,将LPIPS从0.062降至0.049. 4项决议都取得了收益:PSNR增加了0.32至1.29 dB,LPIPS下降了11%至21%。 在联合微调之前,我们模型的PSNR低于官方VAE到1080p;之后,在所有四个分辨率上,它的PSNR是0.07到0.90 dB,而它的LPIPS仍然较高. 当两个单元与正式对应单元配对时,成本是小幅下降(表3)。

blocks.en: Table 8: Joint finetuning.
blocks.zh: 表8:联合微调.

blocks.en: Adversarial loss. Table 9 compares discriminators for the adversarial loss in joint finetuning, whose purpose is to sharpen fine textures, measured by LPIPS. PatchGAN discriminators ( Isola et al., 2017 ) trained from scratch hardly help and can even hurt: at 720p, LPIPS stays at 0.057 or rises to 0.063. They have not learned representations that capture the fine structural detail of ViT outputs, so their feedback does not target the blur. The pretrained Real-ESRGAN U-Net discriminator ( Wang et al., 2021 ) already separates high frequency detail, so it corrects blurry results and missing detail, lowering LPIPS from 0.057 to 0.049 while trading off a negligible 0.07 dB in PSNR at 34.74 dB against 34.81 dB as sharper synthesized textures deviate slightly from pixelwise averages.
blocks.zh: 逆行相损. 表9比较了联合微调中对抗性损失的歧视性因素,其用意是用LPIPS测量来磨削精细的纹理. PatchGAN歧视者(Isola等,2017年)从头接受训练几乎无济于事,甚至会受伤:在720p时,LPIPS停留在0.057或上升至0.063. 他们没有学到能捕捉到ViT输出细微结构细节的表达,因此他们的反馈并不针对模糊. 被预训的Real-ESRGAN U-Net 歧化者(Wang等,2021年)已经分离出高频分化细节,因此校正了模糊结果和缺失细节,将LPIPS从0.057降至0.049,同时将PSNR中可忽略的0.07分贝在34.74分贝与34.81分贝进行交易,因为较锐的合成纹理略微偏离了像素平均.

blocks.zh: 表9:横向损失。

blocks.zh: 4.3.3 推论基础设施

Ours already uses the frame wise 2D decomposition. Table 12 in Appendix B gives the time, memory and quality of each cumulative step at all four resolutions.

blocks.en: Optimized runtime. Fig. 5 (a) reports the end to end speedup, i.e . the encoding plus decoding time of Ours for a 22 frame clip divided by that of each runtime. Attention operator fusion gives 1.7 1.7 – 1.8 × 1.8\times at every resolution by removing the intermediate tensors between normalization, RoPE, window attention and the cross frame merge, and region wise compilation raises it to 2.5 × 2.5\times at 720p and 1080p and 2.2 × 2.2\times at 2160p. FP8 helps only at high resolution: it raises the speedup to 3.0 × 3.0\times at 1080p and 2.7 × 2.7\times at 2160p but lowers it to 2.1 × 2.1\times at 720p and 1.0 × 1.0\times at 480p, because its fixed overhead outweighs the saving at low token counts. FP8 also raises the end to end peak memory by 1.4 to 1.7 GB, so we recommend enabling FP8 only at resolutions of 1080p and above.

QAT recovers it to within 0.13 dB of Ours at every resolution, e.g . 39.07 dB against 39.05 dB at 2160p. QAT training is described in Section 3.4 .

blocks.en: 5  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented LiveVAE, a streaming video VAE that accelerates both encoding and decoding while preserving a pretrained latent space. Our key finding is that a small spatial neighborhood and a short causal temporal window suffice for both components. Causal window attention enables streaming with a bounded KV cache, while three stage distillation maintains compatibility with existing DiTs without retraining. Attention operator fusion, region wise compilation and FFN FP8 with QAT further reduce inference latency. On MiniMax-H3, LiveVAE encodes 5.2 5.2 – 6.2 × 6.2\times and decodes 3.0 3.0 – 3.3 × 3.3\times faster than the official VAE at matching or higher PSNR, and generalizes from training at 720p and below to inference at up to 2160p.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了LiveVAE,一个流动的视频VAE,它既能加速编码,又能解码,同时保留一个事先训练过的潜在空间. 我们的主要发现是,一个小的空间区和一个短暂的因果时间窗口足以满足两个组成部分的需要。 causal window 注意力可以使有界 KV 缓存的流出,而三个相相继分馏则维持与现有的 DiT 兼容而无需再培训. 注意操作员聚变,区域智能编译和与QAT的FFN FP8进一步降低推论延迟. 在MiniMax-H3上,LiveVAE编码为5.2 – 6.2 × 6.2分时并解码为 3.0 3.0分时 3.3分时速快于官方的VAE相匹配或更高PSNR分时速,一般从720p分及以下的训练到最多2160p分的推断.

blocks.en: Limitations and future work. Despite these gains, LiveVAE retains a perceptual quality gap. Fine details can become blurred ( Fig. 6 ), and VBench-2.0 Human Fidelity and Physics remain below the official decoder on MiniMax-H3. We attribute part of this gap to a latent space that was learned by a convolutional VAE. Improving perceptual reconstruction and generation quality without increasing streaming latency is a direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 限制和今后的工作。 尽管取得了这些成绩,LiveVAE仍然保留着一种观念上的质量差距. 细细的细节可能变得模糊(图6),而V Bench-2.0"人类菲德尔"(Human Fidelity and Physics)仍然低于MiniMax-H3上的官方解码器. 我们把这一差距的一部分归结为 一个进化的VAE所学到的潜在空间。 在不增加时间流转的情况下,改善观念重建和生产质量是今后工作的方向。
